dated_fx_sources: FX dates used for ordinary cash flow
issue_projection: This valuation has not been verified as up to date.
sources_acknowledgement_hint: Reconciliation acknowledges the current sources and previously used source states below. Ordinary allocation initializes a baseline only for first ownership; existing notices still require explicit reconciliation.
source_list_unavailable: The source list is incomplete. Return and read a new preview before submitting.
no_accounting_sources: This resource has no individual accounting source records.
no_used_sources: No trade or transfer sources were previously used for ownership.
reverse_ownership_hint: Check current resources and append the opposite ownership entries. Each operation can be reversed once; original trades, transfers and history remain.
reversal_keeps_issues: Source or resource issues still need reconciliation. Reversal does not acknowledge them.
error_already_applied: This source has already been applied, or this operation was reversed. Refresh history and check the existing record.
purpose_definition_hint: Define a purpose and its limits. Resources are assigned separately; saving never changes cash or securities.
valuation_currency_hint: Used for purpose targets and risk comparisons. Existing resources retain their original currencies and quantities.
asset_limit_bps_hint: 100 basis points = 1%. Enter 0–10000; leave empty for no configured limit.
archive_purpose: Archive purpose; keep its history and existing ownership
resource_balances_hint: Each account, currency and security is checked independently. Actual negative balances and purpose excess are separate; unallocated resources are not a reconciliation issue.
funding_partial: Some valuations or sources are unverified. Known original resources remain visible; missing values stay unavailable.
empty_resources: No cash or securities resources are available in this scope.
records_error: Records could not be read. Retry to refresh them.
reconciliation_error: Reconciliation could not be read. The absence of notices does not mean sources are reconciled.
ownership_only: This changes purpose ownership and source acknowledgements. It does not record a trade, send money or change account balances.
operation_RECONCILE: Reconcile ownership and acknowledge current sources
signed_delta_hint: Enter a positive amount to add ownership or a negative amount to release it. Use one line per purpose. Moving between purposes must total zero for this resource. Reconciliation may have no lines to acknowledge sources only.
acknowledge_sources_only: No ownership entries; acknowledge only the specified current sources. Remaining excess or unavailable resources stay unresolved.
allocation_validation_hint: The values above are current resources, followed by the exact changes to submit. Submission checks nonnegative purpose ownership, capacity, conservation and unchanged sources; a source change requires another preview.
history_hint: Append-only operations and original amounts. Source-only acknowledgements appear when viewing all purposes.
fund_issue_excess: Purpose claims exceed the actual available resource
fund_issue_invalidated: A previously acknowledged source was removed or no longer applies
issue_quote: Quote missing or original quote cannot be verified
issue_cost: Cost substitute used; related totals remain unverified
issue_resource: Related resource cannot currently be verified
pending_navigation: This request is still pending or has an unknown outcome. Finish or replay the same request before leaving.
discard_navigation: There are unsaved changes. Discard them and leave?
scope_household: All unarchived accounts and standalone assets / liabilities
scope_flows: Eligible ordinary cash-flow accounts · last 30 days
cost_substitute: Cost substitute, excluded from verified totals
onboard_intro: Record decisions, completed trades and later reviews. Choose a purpose template or begin a decision; assets are never allocated automatically.
onboard_independent: This saves your introduction preference only; it does not change the enable date or allocate resources.
index_pending: The execution index is updating; unlinked results are not complete yet.
index_retry: The execution index is incomplete and will retry.
empty_decisions_hint: Start with an action and its reason. Drafts can be incomplete; unknowns stay unknown.
title: Decision title
title_placeholder: For example: verify costs before adding to a position
no_purposes: No funding purposes yet; you can still save a decision.
no_automatic_allocation: This compares the plan with existing resources. Saving does not allocate or reserve funds.
loss_hint: A scenario is compared with the purpose loss budget; it is not a forecast or realized result.
scenario_tags_hint: Separate with commas or choose existing categories; multiple search tags use intersection.
research_hint: For research, consider what information is missing, the cost of waiting and when to check again.
declared_hint: A date alone is enough; it does not change the system confirmation time.
check_hint: Ordinary saves keep the existing date; clearing it cancels the check. Confirmation does not convert it to a review reminder.
origin_hint: Content origin is a declaration; the system records who saved and confirmed it.
draft_separate: A separate amendment draft exists; the current confirmed version remains effective.
confirmation_hint: The contents and context below will be frozen together. Text cannot change during confirmation; source changes require a new preview.
context_error: Context could not be read. Retry; your draft is preserved.
error_invalid: Check the fields and required values; amounts, quantities and probabilities must be valid.
error_conflict: The ledger, draft or sources changed. Keep your text, reload and preview again.
error_permission: This session is not authorized for that action.
error_unavailable: The related resource cannot be verified right now. Try again later.
error_unknown: The outcome is unknown. Replay the same request below instead of creating another one.
required_alternative: Enter at least one unchosen alternative before confirmation.
no_values_edit: Show values to edit structured amounts and quantities.
comparison_unknown: Cannot determine; related sources are unverified
comparison_owned: Plan is within current purpose ownership
comparison_loss_within: Entered scenario is within the budget
comparison_cash_below: Current cash is below the configured minimum
comparison_cash_within: Current cash meets the configured minimum
comparison_asset_within: Current concentration is within the limit
completed_trade_only: Record a trade that has already happened. This does not place an order.
trade_account_modes: Choose the account where the trade took place.
initialize_manual_before_trade: Create an opening holdings snapshot for this account first.
manual_trade_today: Manual holdings use the current ledger day.
ledger_trade_date_hint: Use the date the trade took place.
manual_trade_currency: Manual holdings use the account currency.
final_posted_cash_hint: Enter the final amount including charges, without a sign. Leave blank if unknown.
blank_fee_unknown: Leave blank if unknown. Enter 0 only if there was no charge.
cash_calibration_hint: Enter an independently verified balance. Any difference appears separately.
trade_fx_hint: Enter {{currency}} per unit of trade currency. Leave blank if unknown.
deviation_reason: Reason for departing from the confirmed plan
plan_unit_unknown: Quantity progress is unavailable because the confirmed and traded units could not be matched.
progress_no_auto_close: Recording trades updates progress. You decide when to close the decision.
impact_mismatch: The trade and account resource changes could not be matched.
negative_cash_notice: Cash is negative after the trade.
manual_unknown_cash_hint: This cash value uses known amounts. Unknown charges still need review.
purpose_share_hint: Assign actual shares by purpose. The totals must match the trade.
explicit_top_up_hint: Enter any cash or quantity to move from unassigned resources into this purpose.
trade_observed_sources_hint: These sources support this assignment. Existing reconciliation items are handled separately.
charges_detail_only: Charges are shown for reference and are already reflected in net cash.
trade_existing_reconciliation: Some items still need separate reconciliation.
deferred_ownership_hint: The trade is linked to the confirmed version. Purpose assignment remains pending, with no purpose entries written now.
trade_ownership_step: Choose how to handle purpose assignment
defer_trade_ownership: Record the trade and reconcile purposes later
trade_requires_reconciliation: Purpose assignment needs more evidence. You can record the trade now.
recheck_changed_shares: The security, side or settlement currency changed. Re-enter the purpose shares.
trade_recorded: Trade recorded and linked to confirmed v{{number}}
trade_ownership_recorded: Purpose shares and top-ups were recorded with the trade.
trade_progress_before_recording: Plan progress before recording this trade
deferred_ownership_preview: Recording will link the trade to the confirmed version. Purpose assignment will stay pending, with no purpose entries written.
trade_no_active_purposes: There are no active purposes to assign this trade to.
transfer_new_hint: Record a completed cash transfer and carry its purpose assignments forward. Use the actual currencies and amounts.
transfer_existing_hint: Carry purpose assignments forward for a recorded transfer. Both original entries are retained.
transfer_share_hint: Enter the outgoing amount to carry forward for each purpose. The preview apportions incoming shares from the actual amounts. Unassigned amounts stay as they are.
transfer_no_candidates: No cash transfer candidates on this page.
transfer_invalid_pair: The selected entry is no longer paired.
correct_ownership_hint: Append an ownership correction while keeping the original allocation history and ledger entries.
correction_signed_hint: Enter a change for each purpose and resource. Positive amounts add ownership and negative amounts remove it.
correction_pending_hint: The preview found existing reconciliation items. Check the current resources after saving for any remaining discrepancies.
correction_reason_required: Enter a reason before previewing the correction.
no_execution_candidates: No trades available to link in this range.
execution_link_evidence_only: Save the evidence link. Purpose ownership is handled separately in reconciliation.
unlink_execution_hint: Remove the decision evidence link. Reconcile or reverse purpose ownership separately. The original link stays in history.
execution_timing_unknown: Order of trade and confirmation is undetermined
queue_filter: Filter by account, security, date or source record
queue_filter_empty: No work items match this filter.
execution_ack_only_hint: Acknowledge the source shown. Existing ownership and any excess remain available for separate reconciliation.
execution_adjust_hint: Acknowledge the source shown and append the previewed ownership adjustments.
execution_ack_only: Acknowledge source and keep current ownership
execution_adjust_unavailable: Adjusting ownership requires available purposes and account resources.
execution_resources_failed: Purposes or account resources could not be loaded. You can still acknowledge the trade source.
queue_incomplete: Trade indexing or date verification is incomplete. Some work items may be missing.
review_empty: This confirmed version has no reviews yet.
review_restart: Restart draft at the same cutoff
review_cutoff_hint: The first save fixes the cutoff and ledger time zone. Start a new review for a different date.
review_preview_hint: Save the draft before previewing submission. Submission requires judgment, execution, and the text of each evidence entry.
review_discard_confirm: Discard this review draft? Historical versions are retained.
review_observed_facts: Facts and evidence at the cutoff
review_no_attribution: These are observations. Separate outcomes, judgment, and alternative explanations in the review.
review_original_decision: Confirmed decision and its original context
review_reminder_hint: When due, the reminder appears in the investment work queue. Draft checks are scheduled separately.
queue_pick_decision_hint: Choose a confirmed decision. Its detail will preselect the trade you picked.
queue_task_changed: The date, version, or trade eligibility changed. Review the current record.
discard_decision_confirm: Discard the current decision draft? Its check will close and history will be retained.
principle_source_review_hint: Start from a review to carry it forward, or enter its exact version ID.
principle_source_status_hint: The snapshot records the review status at publication. A draft can be a reference, and publishing the principle leaves the review as a draft.
principle_draft_hint: Each save appends a draft version. Publication makes that version current.
principle_preview_hint: Save the draft first. Publication requires a name and text. Amending a published principle also requires a reason.
principle_discard_confirm: Discard the current principle draft? Saved versions remain in history.
principle_from_review: Draft a principle from this review
case_no_relation: This version has no recorded principle relationship.
case_derived_principle: Principle version derived from this review
case_match_hint: Results match all selected scenario categories. The record separately identifies explicit principle relationships.
case_empty: No confirmed decisions or submitted reviews match.
case_find_tags: Find cases with the same scenarios
review_detail_unavailable: The exact historical detail is unavailable. The case text below is from the search result.
execution_close_hint: Mark execution as closed. Linked trades and decision history remain available.
execution_reopen_hint: Reopen execution tracking for this confirmed decision.
case_tag_input_hint: Enter or select one scenario category at a time.
stored_quote_unverified: The original quote used for this cached valuation could not be verified.
